bitcoin_core.why: latest tagged release at the time the harness was written; the coin-selection algorithms are used as-is, with only the instrumentation patch in patches/ applied

coin_select.describes: PR #75: per-candidate ancestor sets stored sparsely, on top of PR #73's depth-first branch and bound with the changeless metrics removed
coin_select.why: the ancestor-aware selection work this benchmark exists to measure, traversed depth-first (#73) and with the per-candidate ancestor sets stored flat rather than as one dense bitset each (#75). The dense form cost candidates x ancestors bits and the same in time to walk, which put a 200,000-candidate pool at 1.3 GB and 464 ms of setup before the first node; this pin is what makes the scale tier in `bench.py scale` runnable at all. `Changeless` and `LowestFeeChangeless` are still gone with #73, so the harness runs the wallet track alone
